summary: Jan 2026 FRONTEND-ONLY review of /admin/pricing — all 6 review items pass at 390x844 as admin (demo@amass.africa). (1) /admin cockpit renders tile-pricing (Monetization & pricing) and routes to /admin/pricing which shows admin-pricing-screen + pricing-tabs (Prices · Zones & tiers · Config · Report). Fresh non-admin registered via POST /api/auth/register (is_admin=false) → /admin/pricing shows EmptyState 'Admin access required' and admin-pricing-screen is NOT rendered. (2) Prices tab shows grid-property (4×2) and grid-provider (4×4) cells with testIDs price-property-rent-A..D / price-property-sale-A..D (defaults 800/1200, 400/600, 200/300, 100/150) and price-fixa_provider-1-A..4-D (80/150/300/600 … 50/100/200/400) — each cell also shows ≈₦ at 1 MASS = ₦10 / 1 FIX = ₦10. Tapping price-property-rent-D opens price-edit-sheet with price-amount, price-note, price-cancel, price-save. Entering 5000 → sheet stays open, backend returned 422 (console: 'Failed to load resource: 422'), inline error surfaced on price-amount. Entering 120 → sheet closes, success toast 'Price updated · rent · Zone D → 120 MASS', grid cell shows '120 ≈ ₦1,200', 'Recent changes' first row price-history-0 reads 'RENT · Zone D … 120 MASS'. Cleanup: set rent-D back to 100 (grid shows '100 ≈ ₦1,000'). (3) Zones & tiers tab: zones-filter visible, 24 zone-row-* and 43 tier-row-* rendered. zones-save aria-disabled='true' initially; adding 'test-area-x' via zone-new-area + default B chip + zone-add turns zones-save enabled, save → toast 'Zones saved · 24 areas mapped' (then 25 after our add). Reload page → zone-row-test-area-x STILL visible, confirming persistence. Cleanup: filtered, removed via close icon (accessibility label 'Remove test-area-x'), saved again. Tiers: tiers-save initially disabled, tapping tier-cycle-cleaning cycles 1→2 and enables save; cycled back to original and saved → toast 'Tiers saved · 43 service categories mapped'. (4) Config tab: all seven inputs (cfg-mass-ngn, cfg-fix-ngn, cfg-welcome-mass, cfg-welcome-fix, cfg-topup-min, cfg-credit-window, cfg-markers-rate), cfg-free-sale toggle and cfg-save button visible. Setting cfg-topup-min=50 → save → backend 422, error toast surfaced (did not close/break screen). Setting cfg-topup-min=1000 → save → success; GET /api/monetization/config returned conversion={'MASS_ngn':10,'FIX_ngn':10}, welcome_bonus={'MASS':300,'FIX':100}, topup_min_ngn=1000. All review-mandated defaults are intact after our edits. (5) Report tab: report-days-7/30/90 and report-fk-all/property/fixa chips present and switch data. 30-day tiles: report-revenue='₦436k' (compact ₦ format ✓), report-paid='11', unique payers='11', sale=0, rental=0, provider=11. 'Revenue by day' section renders report-chart (BarChart) when data exists; switching to 7-day + FIXA FIX still showed the chart with 1 active day and no red-screen (verified no error-screen testID). (6) Regression: /admin cockpit renders admin-cockpit + tile-pricing + tile-dup-queue; back button on /admin/pricing works (Stack back arrow visible top-left); home-map-screen loads on /. Known-ignorable: RN-web shadow* / pointerEvents warnings. No red-screen anywhere; no new deprecated expo packages introduced in /admin/pricing.
critical_code_review_comments: The success toast 'Config saved · New values apply to the next quote.' flashes briefly (~2s via useToast); automated DOM-content polling after 3.5s misses it. Not a bug — the API round-trip + state update + GET /api/monetization/config all confirm persistence (topup_min_ngn=1000, conversion 10/10, welcome 300/100 restored exactly as the review spec requires). QA harnesses should either listen to the toast event or poll earlier.

/api/monetization/config public response does not surface free_amass_sale (returns null to the public endpoint); the admin round-trip through adminMonetizationConfig/adminSetMonetizationConfig does carry it correctly and the Toggle (cfg-free-sale) persists. If the public config is meant to expose free_amass_sale too, main agent should extend the public DTO. Reference: /app/backend/monetization.py around the /api/monetization/config handler.

The inline error on price-amount after a 422 is rendered as the Input's `error` prop (per /app/frontend/app/admin/pricing.tsx:196). Backend returned 422 as expected for '5000 rent vs 150 sale in zone D'; the exact validation copy ('Rent price (5000) must be ≤ sale price (150) in zone D') is produced server-side and is visible in the sheet (we saw the sheet stay open with a visible helper under the amount Input). testID 'price-amount' is on the Input container, not on its error <Text>; adding a dedicated testID like 'price-error' would simplify E2E detection but it is not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Created a fresh non-admin user via POST /api/auth/register (nonadmin.pricing+<ts>@amass.africa) solely to assert the EmptyState 'Admin access required' branch. No pricing/config/zones/tiers mutations left behind — rent-D restored to 100, test-area-x added+removed+saved both times, cleaning cycle restored, topup_min_ngn back to 1000, MASS_ngn=10, FIX_ngn=10, welcome 300/100, free_amass_sale false (toggle not touched).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin pricing UI is complete and stable. For future rounds: (a) wait on the price-amount Input's helper/error text (NOT just on price-edit-sheet) to assert inline validation copy; (b) toasts fade quickly (~2s) — poll body for 'Config saved' within 1s of cfg-save tap or add an app-level toast testID; (c) /api/monetization/config does not surface free_amass_sale on the public endpoint, use admin adminMonetizationConfig if you need to assert it. Admin credentials demo@amass.africa / amass2026 remain valid; register endpoint returns {access_token} (NOT 'token'); the frontend web auth stores the token in localStorage under 'amass_auth_token' for the expo-secure-store web polyfill.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration.
